documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Sheetal Universal Limited published its Annual Report for the financial year 2024-25, reporting a total revenue of Rs. 1080.65 Lakhs and a Profit of Rs. 9320.9 Lakhs for the year. The company's management highlighted a positive demand outlook driven by global and domestic priorities on food security and sustainability, while noting risks related to raw material price fluctuations and currency variations. Management recommended a final dividend of Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: The agriculture and agro-based industries have demonstrated significant potential for sustained growth.
demand_outlook.quote: The agriculture and agro-based industries, in particular, have demonstrated significant potential for sustained growth.

demand_outlook.claim: As global and domestic markets continue to prioritize food security and sustainability, the demand for high-quality agricultural products is expected to rise substantially.
demand_outlook.quote: As global and domestic markets continue to prioritize food security and sustainability, the demand for high-quality agricultural products is expected to rise substantially.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for the industry remains positive, with strong demand projected for the coming years, both in domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The outlook for the industry remains positive, with strong demand projected for the coming years, both in domestic and international markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that as the company deals in agriculture-based products, there is significant potential demand anticipated for future years.
demand_outlook.quote: As ours is the agriculture based products, there is lot of potential demand for the next years.

capex_expansion.claim: New machineries were installed to provide better result and to cope up with changing requirement of the industry.
capex_expansion.quote: New machineries were installed to provide better result and to cope up with changing requirement of the industry.

capex_expansion.claim: As a long-term planning strategy, company is planning to operate on a larger scale and achieve the highest portion of market demand of its products.
capex_expansion.quote: As a long-term planning strategy, company is planning to operate on a larger scale and achieve the highest portion of market demand of its products.

capex_expansion.claim: The company came out with an IPO and is looking for new products and machinery for expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Also company is come up with IPO in f.y. 2023-24 and looks for new products and machinery for expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Initiatives are being taken by the Company for improving the quality standards and reduction of costs at appropriate level.
margins_costs.quote: The initiatives are being taken by the Company for improving the quality standards and reduction of costs at appropriate level.

margins_costs.claim: Operating expenses were recorded at Rs. 1,271,979 thousands during the financial year 2023-24.
margins_costs.quote: The operating Expenses of Rs. 1271979 thousands during FY 2023-24, as compared to previous financial year 2022-23 incurred of Rs. 1267295 thousands.

margins_costs.claim: Depreciation expenses for the financial year 2023-24 stood at Rs. 8,232 thousands.
margins_costs.quote: The depreciation Expenses of Rs. 8232 thousands during FY 2023-24, as compared to previous financial year 2022-23 incurred of Rs. 6331 thousands showing decrease as compared to previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Finance costs incurred during the financial year 2023-24 amounted to Rs. 14,355 thousands.
margins_costs.quote: The finance cost of Rs. 14355 thousands during FY 2023-24, as compared to previous financial year 2022-23 incurred of Rs. 9232 thousands.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors have decided to retain the entire amount of profit for F.Y. 2024-25 in the Statement of Profit & Loss as at March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors have decided to retain the entire amount of profit for F.Y. 2024-25 in the Statement of Profit & Loss as at March 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: Your directors recommend a Dividend of Rs. 0.5 (i.e. 5% per share) per equity share of face value of Rs. 10/- as Final Dividend for the financial year ended on 31st March, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Your directors recommend a Dividend of Rs. 0.5 (i.e. 5% per share) per equity share of face value of Rs. 10/- as Final Dividend for the financial year ended on 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Company has not accepted any deposits from the public, within the meaning of Section 73 of the Act.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not accepted any deposits from the public, within the meaning of Section 73 of the Act, read with the Companies (Acceptance of Deposits) Rules,2014and hence there are no unpaid/unclaimed deposits nor there is any default in repayment thereof.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided to retain the entire amount of profit for fiscal year 2023-24 in the Statement of Profit & Loss.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors have decided to retain the entire amount of profit for F.Y. 2023-24 in the Statement of Profit & Loss as at March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, after considering holistically the relevant circumstances and keeping in view the Company’s dividend track, has decided that it would be prudent, not to recommend any Dividend for the year under review.

risks_headwinds.claim: Major fluctuations Rupee price value corresponding to fluctuation in the raw material price and stringent market conditions can affect the company's performance.
risks_headwinds.quote: Major fluctuations Rupee price value corresponding to fluctuation in the raw material price and stringent market conditions can affect the company's performance.

risks_headwinds.claim: Product risk, risk of fluctuation in the raw material price, government policies, and financial risk can affect the company, which requires continuous follow up.
risks_headwinds.quote: Product risk, risk of fluctuation in the raw material price, government policies, and financial risk can affect the company, which requires continuous follow up.

management_commitments.claim: M/s Sunit M Chhatbar & Co. shall hold the office of the Statutory Auditors of the Company until the conclusion of the ensuing Annual General Meeting.
management_commitments.quote: RESOLVED FURTHER THAT M/s Sunit M Chhatbar & Co. (FRN: 141068W) Chartered Accountants, Rajkot, be and are hereby appointed as the Statutory Auditors of the Company and that they shall hold the office of the Statutory Auditors of the Company until the conclusion of the ensuing Annual General Meeting

management_commitments.claim: M/s Sunit M Chhatbar & Co. are appointed as Statutory Auditors of the Company for a term of five years to hold office from the conclusion of 10th Annual General Meeting till the conclusion of 16th Annual General Meeting.
management_commitments.quote: M/s Sunit M Chhatbar & Co. (FRN: 141068W) Chartered Accountants, Rajkot, ,be and are hereby appointed as Statutory Auditors of the Company for a term of five years to hold office from the conclusion of 10th Annual General Meeting till the conclusion of 16th Annual General Meeting at a remuneration of Rs. 4,50,000 p.a.
